breaking.change: Returns a native Float32Array transferred over the OGB1 binary wire instead of a JSON number array.
breaking.fix: Consume the returned Float32Array directly (or wrap with Array.from(...) only if a plain JS Array is required).

breaking.change: BspResult.cells is now a native Uint8Array transferred over binary wire (0 wall, 1 room, 2 corridor), and BspResult gains room-graph edges.
breaking.fix: Read cells directly as a Uint8Array; indexing and length work identically, or call Array.from(res.cells) if a plain JS Array is required.

breaking.change: WfcResult.tiles is now a Uint32Array and WfcResult.rotations is now a Uint8Array transferred over binary wire.
breaking.fix: Read tiles and rotations directly as TypedArrays; indexing works identically, or convert with Array.from(...) if a plain JS Array is required.

added.summary: Deterministic seed on og.Clouds driving 3D cloud-noise phase offset so different worlds generate distinct cloud formations.

Added analytical gradient noise (noiseGrad), divergence-free curl noise (curlNoise), Worley cellular F1/F2 (worley), ridged/billow/worley/worleyEdge FbmDesc kinds, multi-octave domain warping, toroidal Poisson-disk wrap, BSP loop corridors and room adjacency edges, procedural eroded heightmap/biome generation (heightmap), procedural plant mesh generation (plant), and deterministic 3D Voronoi mesh fracture (fracture).
Create live procedural terrains at run time from height, control and hole TypedArrays, with full renderer, physics heightfield collider, sampling, editing, stamping and restore support.
TerrainSample now reports the dominant biome/control layer index (layer).
Added deterministic runtime procedural sound synthesis (og.audio.synth returning Float32Array PCM, and og.audio.createSynthSound registering directly into the sound bank).

Upgraded og.render.bufferGeometry, og.render.updateGeometry, og.audio.createSound, og.load.dataBytes, og.tilemap.fill, og.nav.grid, og.terrain.create and og.procgen bulk buffers to zero-JSON 8-byte-aligned TypedArray binary transfers.

fixed.summary: Rebuilt volumetric cloud 3D Worley/Perlin noise (full-range multi-octave fBM with vertical decorrelation), Nubis anvil/coverage/height-gradient shaping, dual-lobe Henyey-Greenstein + Beer-Powder + sunlit sunset/twilight/night scattering, jittered raymarcher with adaptive step refinement and full transmittance depth blending, and motion-reprojected variance-clamped temporal resolve.

Unified deterministic IEEE-safe Perlin/Simplex/Worley/curl/analytic-derivative noise and GPU noise.wgsl, fixed PCG32 bounded integer bias, fixed Poisson-disk spatial grid bounds, and upgraded WFC to AC-4 constraint propagation with Shannon entropy.

Fixed sky LUT/aurora/lightning determinism and coordinate consistency, ocean FFT Phillips/JONSWAP spectrum symmetry and buoyancy parity, 2D fluid/wind advection stability, terrain/grass/scatter placement parity, SFX PolyBLEP/SVF synthesis quality, and og-shape Voronoi/district/fracture edge cases.
